title: Quantum Stokes matrices and quantum Riemann-Hilbert-Birkhoff maps
summary: In this paper, we define quantum Stokes matrices of meromorphic linear systems of ordinary differential equations with noncommutative coefficients and a pole of order $p+1$. We prove that these quantum Stokes matrices satisfy natural quantum exchange relations. These relations allow us to interpret the quantum Stokes matrices as an associative algebra homomorphism, which may be viewed as a quantization of the Riemann-Hilbert-Birkhoff map, regarded as a Poisson map, for meromorphic connections.
